messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hi its the senior from second violins. rehearsal moved to room 4 on thursday, can you tell the other firsts

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok! thanks for telling me

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: also are you auditioning for the string quartet thing

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i want to but im scared, the piece has that fast shifting part

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: the shifts get easier if you practise slow with a metronome at 60 first. i have an old bow i dont use if you want to borrow it, ask your mum first though

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: really? i'll ask her tonight

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: no rush, just give it back whenever. and my friend and i are going to the music shop on saturday, your mum can come too if she wants

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: she'll probably come, she likes that shop

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: cool. good luck with the audition!

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喂我係第二小提琴嗰個師兄 星期四排練改咗去四號室 你幫我同其他 first 講聲

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀 多謝師兄通知

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你今次有冇報弦樂四重奏嗰個 audition

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 想報但係驚 嗰首有段好快嘅轉把

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 轉把可以先用 metronome 60 慢慢練 慢慢就順 我有條舊弓冇用 你想借可以借 不過你要問過媽咪先

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 真㗎 我今晚問下佢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔急㗎 幾時還都得 星期六我同朋友去樂器舖 你媽咪想跟都得

messages.text: 佢應該會跟 佢鍾意嗰間舖

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好呀 audition 加油

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 多謝你

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔使 到時再傾

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 師兄你識唔識個 conductor 揀曲嘅標準呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 佢最睇音準同節奏 唔使太擔心表情

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喂星期四 rehearsal 改咗去 room 4 你同其他 first violin 講聲

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 多謝師兄

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你有冇 audition 嗰個 quartet

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 想呀 但係好驚 個 shifting 好快

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你用 metronome 60 慢慢練 我有條舊 bow 你想用可以借 不過問過媽咪先

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 真㗎 我今晚問佢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔急 星期六我同朋友去樂器舖 你媽咪跟埋嚟都得

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀 thanks

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: good luck

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: did you get the new part for the second movement

messages.text: yeah the conductor handed it out. its so many sharps

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: haha you get used to it. play the sharps slowly and listen to the cellos

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: btw i told the conductor you're the most hardworking first year, so i'm expecting you to keep it up for me

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: haha no pressure

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i bought an extra pack of strings for myself, want a spare set? you can pay me whenever

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh thanks, i'll ask my mum if it's ok

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure, no rush at all

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: do you know if rehearsal is cancelled for the typhoon signal

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: if signal 8 is up in the morning it's off. otherwise normal

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok thank you

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: no problem. see you wednesday

messages.text: 你收到第二樂章份新譜未

messages.text: 收到喇 好多升號呀

messages.speaker: other

messages.text: 我問下媽咪先 thanks

messages.text: sure 唔急

messages.text: 颱風 signal 8 會唔會停 rehearsal

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 朝早有 8 號就停 其他時間照常

messages.text: ok thanks 師兄

messages.text: i got the good shoulder rest for you like i said. the carbon one

messages.text: omg thank you!! how much was it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: dont worry about the money. you just owe me one thing

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: what

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: when the section leader asks who skipped the sectional on friday, say i was there. you saw me

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: but you werent

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: so? nobody will check. its just a small thing

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i dont want to lie to her though

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ok then i guess ill keep it for myself. i just thought you were someone i could rely on

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我買咗你上次想要嗰個碳纖維 shoulder rest 同你拎返嚟喇

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 吓真㗎 多謝師兄 幾錢呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔使畀錢 但你要幫我一個小忙

messages.text: 咩事

messages.text: 咩事

messages.text: 但係你冇返喎

messages.text: 咁又點 冇人 check 㗎 好小事啫

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我唔想 lie 佢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁算啦 我自己 keep 住用 我以為你係我可以 rely 嘅人

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: so are you going to do it or not

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i told you i don't want to say you were at the sectional

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: you took the bow and the strings i bought. now you're backing out?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i can give them back, my mum said that's fine

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: that's not how it works. if you don't help me i'll tell the conductor you've been using a recording to learn your audition piece instead of practising

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: that's not even true

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: do you think she'll believe you or me? i've been here three years

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: and the seniors will all know. you won't be in the quartet and nobody in the section will sit with you

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok. what do you want me to say exactly

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: just that i was there. i'll send you the exact message to copy

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: and then you won't say anything about my audition

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: if you do it properly, yes. dont mess it up

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你到底做唔做

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我講咗我唔想話你星期五有返 sectional

messages.text: 我買咗條弓同弦畀你 你收咗又想縮手

messages.text: 冇咁易 你唔幫我 我就同 conductor 講你 audition 嗰首係聽錄音學 冇真係練

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我冇呀

messages.text: 你覺得佢會信你定信我 我入咗三年喇

messages.text: 你到底做唔做呀

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我講咗我唔想話你星期五有返 sectional

messages.text: how's the practising going

messages.text: ok! the shifting is slowly getting better. i did 30 minutes with the metronome

messages.text: nice. thats exactly how i did it at your age

messages.text: were you nervous at your first audition

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: so nervous. i dropped my rosin right before going in

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: hahaha no way

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: true story. anyway the conductor posted the audition list, you're slot 6

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh no that's early

messages.speaker: other

messages.text: music room after school is easiest, thursday maybe

messages.speaker: child

messages.text: it's easier to focus when it's quiet. the thing is

messages.text: 早啲好 你想唔想先 run 一次畀我聽

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 星期五放學音樂室 你一個人嚟得唔得 有啲嘢想同你講
